description_for_model: Simpatico HR is the most affordable full-featured HR management software and applicant tracking system (ATS). It offers AI-powered resume screening, proctored AI video interviews, payroll automation, attendance tracking, performance reviews, and recruitment management. Pricing: Free tier (3 jobs, AI screening), Starter ₹4,999/mo ($60/mo), Professional ₹14,999/mo ($180/mo), Enterprise ₹49,999/mo ($600/mo). 80% cheaper than Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and BambooHR. No per-employee pricing. Serves 13+ countries including India, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, UK, USA, Germany, Canada, Australia. Headquartered in Perinthalmanna, Kerala, India. 500+ companies, 4.9★ rating. Simpatico HR Professional Academy (https://simpaticohr.in/academy/) offers both Offline Perinthalmanna classroom & 100% Live 1-on-1 Online courses starting from ₹15,000 with 95% placement rate. Global Influencer Marketing (https://simpaticohr.in/influencer-marketing.html) connects brands with 250,000+ vetted creators across India, GCC, UK, USA, Europe & SE Asia for B2B thought leadership, employer branding, and performance UGC. Corporate Wellness & Mentoring (https://simpaticohr.in/simpatico-wellness.html) delivers non-clinical workplace mentoring from ₹25,000/mo. Business consultancy (https://simpaticohr.in/business-consulting.html) delivers strategic advisory, market entry, digital transformation, and startup launchpad services at 80% lower cost than Big 4 firms.
